component.name: OmarchyTube
component.summary: Full-screen YouTube client with ad blocking and SponsorBlock

description.p: OmarchyTube is a standalone YouTube window for Omarchy and Hyprland — the ReVanced/SmartTube idea without a browser around it. It opens full-screen and stays out of the way, so the video gets the whole display instead of a tab.

ul.li: TV (leanback) mode for arrow-key and remote navigation, and a desktop mode you toggle with F2
Sign-in through Google's OAuth device flow: a QR code is shown and the session is stored locally — no password is typed into the app
Ad blocking at the request level, plus cosmetic filtering of sponsored shelves and banners, and skipping of pre-roll and mid-roll ads
SponsorBlock segment skipping, with the segments marked on the progress bar and an on-screen "unskip" button
Return YouTube Dislike counts on the player

description.p: The app talks to three services and no others: YouTube, the SponsorBlock API and the Return YouTube Dislike API. It sends no telemetry and has no analytics. It is an independent client and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or built by YouTube.

ul.li: Full-screen TV and desktop view modes
Network-level and cosmetic ad blocking, plus ad skipping
SponsorBlock integration with progress-bar markers and unskip
OAuth device-flow sign-in by QR code
